country: Al Imarat al Arabiyah al Muttahidah

fields.terrain: flat, barren coastal plain merging into rolling sand dunes of vast desert; mountains in east
fields.farm: dates, cucumbers/gherkins, camel milk, goat milk, tomatoes, chicken, goat meat, eggs, milk, camel meat
fields.exports: crude petroleum, refined petroleum, gold, broadcasting equipment, natural gas
fields.industries: petroleum and petrochemicals; fishing, aluminum, cement, fertilizer, commercial ship repair, construction materials, handicrafts, textiles
fields.languages: Arabic (official), English, Hindi, Malayalam, Urdu, Pashto, Tagalog, Persian
fields.religions: Muslim 74.5% (official) (Sunni 63.3%, Shia 6.7%, other 4.4%), Christian 12.9%, Hindu 6.2%, Buddhist 3.2%, agnostic 1.3%, other 1.9%
fields.legal: mixed system of Islamic (sharia) law and civil law
fields.military: 18-40 for voluntary service; 18-30 years of age for compulsory national service for men with a 36-month service obligation for those without a secondary education and 11 months for secondary school…
